policy.note: Hard-reviewed gap pass Jönköping + Kronoberg + Västmanland (Sala) ZERO-vatten targets. Empty better than wrong. Allowed: Naturkartan prose (not Arter icons), vattenagarna, municipal/tourism/brochures, FVOF/Wayback, LST/miljö/nätprovfiske PDFs, newspapers, Hitta Fiske prose, iFiske Om-prose for named water. Never: Artportalen, NatureIT, iFiske Fiskarter icons, Fishbrain, forums, catch reports. 1:1 FVO↔source; species ⊆ arter_fvo; multi-lake only per named water or explicit all named lakes; no fuzzy twins.
